name: saraya-livestock
description: منظومة السرايا لإدارة مزارع الماشية والألبان والتسمين - Saraya Livestock & Dairy Farm ERP
author: Saraya Team

scripts.build:all: npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push:dev: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push
scripts.contracts:generate: cd apps/api && npm run openapi:generate && cd ../web && npm run openapi:generate
scripts.contracts:check: cd apps/api && npm run openapi:check && cd ../.. && node scripts/check-openapi-contract.mjs && cd apps/web && npm run openapi:check && npm run api:check-boundaries
